name: dynomapper-mcp
description: The DYNO Mapper MCP servers: stdio for npm, Streamable HTTP for containers.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @dynomapper/mcp-server && npm run build -w @dynomapper/mcp-http
scripts.check: npm run check -ws --if-present && vp check vite.config.ts scripts
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run check:secrets && npm run check:changelogs && npm test && npm run build && npm run check:artifact
